data.body_html:
A Marbella yacht charter sunset cruise is one of the most romantic experiences on the Costa del Sol. As the sun dips behind La Concha and the Mediterranean turns gold, sharing a carefully planned dinner on the water elevates the evening from memorable to magical. Whether you're celebrating an anniversary, proposing, or simply treating someone special, the right menu and setting make all the difference. Here are our top romantic dinner menu ideas, practical catering tips, and boat recommendations for your sunset cruise from Puerto Banús.

Why Choose a Sunset Cruise from Puerto Banús

Puerto Banús is the perfect departure point for a sunset dinner cruise. The marina is surrounded by upscale restaurants and shops, making it easy to pick up a gourmet picnic or pre-order a full meal. From the port, it's a short 15-minute cruise to calm anchorages like Cabopino or Cala del Faro, where you can watch the sun set over the Sierra Blanca. Our boats depart between 19:00 and 20:00, returning around 22:00–23:00—ideal timing for a relaxed dinner under the stars.

Romantic Dinner Menu Ideas for Your Yacht Charter

Your menu should be light, easy to serve on a boat, and full of Mediterranean flavours. Here are three curated ideas:

  • Spanish Tapas Feast – Jamón ibérico, manchego cheese, patatas bravas, gambas al ajillo, pimientos de padrón, and crusty bread. Pair with a chilled Albariño or cava.
  • Seafood Platter – Oysters, king prawns, lobster tails, grilled octopus, and a citrus salad. Serve with rosé or a crisp Verdejo.
  • 5-Course Mediterranean Dinner – Ceviche starter, tomato gazpacho, seafood paella, grilled sea bass with vegetables, and churros with chocolate for dessert. Add a bottle of Rioja or a local Moscatel.

For dessert, fresh fruit skewers, mini tartlets, or a simple chocolate fondue work beautifully. Don't forget to bring a bottle of cava for a sunset toast—we already include it in your charter, but you can upgrade to Champagne.

Catering Options: Bring Your Own or Order In

You have three flexible options for dinner on board. First, bring your own food and drinks—our boats have fridges, ice boxes, and basic crockery. Second, order from a local restaurant for delivery to the boat before departure; many Puerto Banús restaurants offer takeaway or picnic hampers. Third, arrange a private chef to cook on board—this is our most popular choice for romantic occasions. We can coordinate everything for you; just let us know at least 48 hours in advance. Dietary requirements (vegan, gluten-free, allergies) are easily accommodated.

Best Boats for a Romantic Sunset Dinner

For an intimate dinner for two, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal. Both have a spacious cockpit table and a flybridge where you can dine al fresco. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT. If you want more space and luxury, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offers a large aft deck and salon dining, from €4,719 for 4 hours (includes a free jet ski). For a full list of options, browse our fleet.

What to Expect on a Sunset Cruise

Your skipper will greet you at Puerto Banús, help you load your dinner, and give a safety briefing. You'll cruise along the coast to a quiet anchorage—Cabopino, Cala del Faro, or off the Golden Mile. The skipper will drop anchor, and you'll have 1–2 hours to enjoy your meal and the sunset. The boat is equipped with a sound system, so bring your playlist. As darkness falls, you'll cruise back to port under the stars. The entire experience is relaxed and private; your skipper stays out of sight unless needed.

Tips for the Perfect Romantic Evening

  • Book early – Sunset slots are popular, especially June–September. Reserve at least a week ahead.
  • Dress in layers – Evenings can be cool on the water, even in summer. Bring a light jacket or shawl.
  • Bring a camera – The sunset over La Concha is unforgettable. A phone or small camera is fine.
  • Consider a surprise – Proposals, anniversary toasts, or birthday celebrations can be arranged with flowers, cake, or a personalised menu.
  • Communicate dietary needs – Let us know allergies or preferences when booking so we can advise on catering.
